scenarios.title: FastAPI Async JSON Serialization
scenarios.description: Uvicorn ASGI event loop queries enterprise_seed.db for users & products, hydratively validates Pydantic schemas, serializes nested JSON responses.

scenarios.title: Express.js High Churn REST Endpoints
scenarios.description: High churn REST endpoints serving dynamic order and catalog routes with Connection: close, forcing rapid socket churn and V8 GC pressure.

scenarios.title: Go Chi Lightweight HTTP Gateway
scenarios.description: Zero-allocation Go Chi routing gateway with middleware chain (RequestID, RealIP, Context timeout) and direct struct JSON serialization.

scenarios.title: Rust Axum Multi-Core Microservice
scenarios.description: Rust Axum multi-threaded service on Tokio runtime with lock-free channel dispatch and SIMD-accelerated serde_json serialization.

scenarios.title: Nginx Reverse Proxy & Keep-Alive Pooling
scenarios.description: Nginx epoll core maintaining upstream keep-alive connection pool (keepalive 64), proxying requests to local backends and buffering responses.

scenarios.title: Nginx TLS Handshake Session Resumption
scenarios.description: OpenSSL TLS 1.3 crypto engine testing new handshakes and session ticket resumption with genuine 2048-bit RSA/ECDSA certificates.

scenarios.title: GraphQL Nested Entity Resolution
scenarios.description: GraphQL AST parsing and DataLoader batching across 4 relational levels (User -> Orders -> Items -> Product -> Reviews) over enterprise_seed.db.

scenarios.title: Django WSGI Synchronous Worker Turnover
scenarios.description: Gunicorn WSGI managing sync workers with max-requests=500, forcing live process recycling and testing OS copy-on-write page cleanup.

scenarios.title: HTTP/2 Multiplexed Stream Saturation
scenarios.description: HTTP/2 multiplexing up to 100 concurrent streams per TCP socket connection using binary framing, HPACK header compression, and window flow control.

scenarios.title: gRPC Protobuf Bi-Directional Streaming
scenarios.description: Bi-directional gRPC streaming RPCs serializing and deserializing compiled Protocol Buffer binary wire format without textual overhead.

scenarios.title: Server-Sent Events (SSE) Fan-Out (5,000 clients)
scenarios.description: Event broadcaster holding 5,000 persistent HTTP connection sockets broadcasting live ticker and order events across open socket descriptors.

scenarios.title: WebSocket Full-Duplex Real-Time Churn
scenarios.description: RFC 6455 full-duplex WebSocket server exchanging masked binary and JSON frames with heartbeat ping/pong and high connection churn rate.

scenarios.title: Resilience4j / Envoy Circuit Breaker Trips
scenarios.description: Circuit breaker state machine (Closed -> Open -> Half-Open) verifying fast-fail responses (503/429 < 0.5ms) under injected upstream failure.

scenarios.title: OAuth2 JWT Cryptographic Token Validation
scenarios.description: Auth gateway verifying RFC 7519 HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens, validating base64url decoding, cryptographic signatures, expiration, and scopes.

scenarios.title: Rate Limiter Leaky Bucket Throttling
scenarios.description: High-performance token/leaky bucket rate limiter enforcing 5,000 req/sec limit per token with standard HTTP 429 backpressure headers.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL TPC-B Transaction Ingestion
scenarios.description: Standard TPC-B transaction workload (3 UPDATEs, 1 SELECT, 1 INSERT) testing disk WAL writeback (fdatasync), row locking, and shared buffer cache.

scenarios.title: SQLite WAL High-Concurrency Concurrent Read-Writes
scenarios.description: SQLite 3 embedded database on scratch volume in WAL mode with 16 concurrent reader threads and 2 writer threads executing ACID order insertions.

scenarios.title: Redis 7 Pipelined GET/SET Cache Operations
scenarios.description: Redis 7 executing batch pipelined commands (16 commands per pipeline) testing socket buffer batching, amortized syscalls, and event loop throughput.

scenarios.title: Redis BGSAVE Copy-on-Write Memory Pressure
scenarios.description: Redis holding a 1.5 GB dataset under intensive writes. Periodic BGSAVE triggers fork() and copy-on-write page faults, testing memory ceilings.

scenarios.title: Valkey High-Throughput Cluster Sharding
scenarios.description: Valkey high-throughput key-value engine with multi-threaded I/O and hash slot routing (CRC16 % 16384) over enterprise session and inventory data.

scenarios.title: PgBouncer Connection Multiplexing (5,000 clients)
scenarios.description: PgBouncer in transaction pooling mode multiplexing 5,000 client connection sockets into 25 backend PostgreSQL connections.

scenarios.title: SQLite FTS5 BM25 Full-Text Search Queries
scenarios.description: SQLite FTS5 virtual table indexing 40,000 genuine customer reviews, querying natural English keywords with BM25 statistical relevance ranking.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL Lock Contention & Deadlock Detection
scenarios.description: Concurrent transactions competing for overlapping row-level locks on hot account records, exercising deadlock_timeout and lock manager queues.

scenarios.title: PostgreSQL MVCC Table Bloat & Auto-VACUUM
scenarios.description: High-churn UPDATE stream generating dead tuples in heap pages, triggering background autovacuum and measuring visibility map updates.

scenarios.title: Redis Sorted Sets (ZSET) Leaderboard Ingestion
scenarios.description: Redis Sorted Sets tracking live user rankings with high-frequency ZADD, ZREVRANGEBYSCORE, and ZRANK operations testing SkipList rebalancing.

scenarios.title: Key-Value Range Scans under Continuous Writes
scenarios.description: Sorted Key-Value engine executing range scans concurrently with 10,000 writes/sec, evaluating snapshot read isolation and write amplification.

scenarios.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion & Queue Backpressure
scenarios.description: Application connection pool strictly bounded to 10 connections subjected to 1,000 concurrent client requests, testing queue backpressure and 503 rejection.

scenarios.title: Multipart File Upload (1 MB - 25 MB chunks)
scenarios.description: Receives chunked multipart uploads containing genuine binary JPEG and PNG images (1 MB to 25 MB), streams them to scratch storage, and validates SHA-256 checksums.

scenarios.title: Linux sendfile(2) Zero-Copy Kernel Transfer
scenarios.description: Zero-copy static media server streaming large video/binary buffers directly from VFS page cache into client TCP sockets via sendfile(2) without userspace copying.

scenarios.title: MinIO S3 Compatible Object Storage Benchmark
scenarios.description: MinIO / S3 object storage server executing AWS SigV4 PutObject, GetObject, and ListObjectsV2 with authentic MD5/SHA-256 ETag verification on scratch NVMe.

scenarios.title: Maildir 100,000 Small File Inode Churn
scenarios.description: Maildir message spool simulating MTA delivery: atomic file creation in tmp/, rename() to new/, reader processing to cur/, and concurrent unlink() across 100,000 inodes.

scenarios.title: fdatasync Saturation & Disk Write Barriers
scenarios.description: Multiple worker threads write 4 KB to 64 KB records to append-only journals in /scratch, flooding page cache to vm.dirty_ratio and issuing batched fdatasync() barriers.

scenarios.title: FIO Direct I/O (O_DIRECT) Kernel Bypass
scenarios.description: Flexible I/O Tester (FIO) with io_uring or libaio engine and direct=1. Bypasses page cache with 4 KB blocks, 70/30 randrw distribution, and iodepth=64 on scratch NVMe.

scenarios.title: libvips SIMD Multithreaded Image Transcoding
scenarios.description: Multithreaded image processing pipeline ingesting genuine JPEG photos, performing SIMD bilinear resize, sharpening convolution, and WebP compression.

scenarios.title: mmap Shared Memory Concurrent Updates
scenarios.description: Memory-maps a 2 GB binary database file on /scratch via MAP_SHARED. 16 worker threads execute concurrent atomic random read-modify-writes via CAS followed by periodic msync().

scenarios.title: Disk Queue Saturation & Block I/O Throttling
scenarios.description: Background generators write continuous 64 MB chunk files to saturate disk queue, while foreground reader threads issue 4 KB index lookups, evaluating I/O fairness under dirty page flush.

scenarios.title: Temporary File Churn & Directory Re-indexing
scenarios.description: Rapidly creates, scans, indexes, and deletes deep directory trees containing 50,000 temporary object files across 500 subdirectories, stressing dentry hash tables and directory block expansion.

scenarios.title: RabbitMQ AMQP 0-9-1 Topic Exchange Fanout
scenarios.description: AMQP topic exchange bound to 5 durable queues with wildcard routing keys, testing topic trie matching, disk persistence, and consumer acknowledgments.

scenarios.title: NATS Core Pub/Sub High-Velocity Routing
scenarios.description: Pure in-memory subject hierarchy routing with 50 subscriber worker groups over multiplexed client sockets with sub-millisecond dispatch.

scenarios.title: ZeroMQ PUSH/PULL Lock-Free Socket Pipeline
scenarios.description: 8 pipeline worker threads connected via ZMQ_PULL receiving 1 KB task batches from central ZMQ_PUSH socket, validating HMAC signatures and high water mark (HWM=10,000).

scenarios.title: Prometheus 10,000 Metrics/Sec Pull Scrapes
scenarios.description: Serves /metrics endpoint emitting 10,000 distinct time-series metrics in OpenMetrics text exposition format (counters, gauges, histograms) under concurrent scrape load.

scenarios.title: Vector High-Throughput JSON Log Ingestion
scenarios.description: Listens on TCP port 9514 for streaming newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) logs up to 25,000 events/sec, parsing fields, validating schemas, and writing to disk buffers.

scenarios.title: OpenTelemetry Distributed Span Ingestion
scenarios.description: Ingests OTLP distributed traces over gRPC/HTTP2 on port 4317. Decodes batches of 100 nested spans (ResourceSpans, ScopeSpans, Span) with attributes, events, and status.

scenarios.title: StatsD UDP High-Rate Metric Aggregation
scenarios.description: Receives UDP datagrams containing batched metric lines (counter, latency ms, gauge) bounded within 1,472 bytes (safe MTU payload limit) at 100,000 datagrams/sec.

scenarios.title: Kafka-compatible Streaming Partition Writes
scenarios.description: Implements Kafka binary wire protocol ProduceRequest, writing record batches to 16 active topic partitions on disk with CRC32C hardware acceleration.

scenarios.title: Backpressure Event Streaming Flow Control
scenarios.description: Streams continuous telemetry events to connected clients. Detects TCP send buffer saturation (EAGAIN / EPOLLOUT) when client reading halts, pausing producer without blowing heap memory.

scenarios.title: Message Priority Re-ordering under Contention
scenarios.description: Priority queues (priority 1-10) with 100,000 backlog messages ensuring priority 10 emergency alerts are delivered ahead of low-priority traffic without priority inversion.

scenarios.title: TCP TIME_WAIT Ephemeral Port Exhaustion
scenarios.description: HTTP server with Connection: close and zero SO_LINGER actively closing sockets. Slot C blasts 2,000 conns/sec across ephemeral ports (32768-60999) evaluating tcp_tw_reuse.

scenarios.title: Gradual Memory Leak (5 MB/sec) & Allocator Behavior
scenarios.description: HTTP service retaining uncollected chunk allocations in a ring buffer on every request (5 MB/s leak rate). Tracks memory fragmentation, RSS drift, and supervisor memory warning.

scenarios.title: Unclosed File Descriptor Leak (ulimit ceiling)
scenarios.description: HTTP service leaking socket handles or scratch file descriptors on error code paths until hitting the 10,000 FD ceiling (EMFILE). Verifies event loop doesn't spin at 100% CPU.

scenarios.title: SIGKILL Worker Process Instant Termination & Restart
scenarios.description: Supervised multi-worker HTTP server under live 2,000 QPS load subjected to periodic SIGKILL worker termination (kill -9). Measures supervisor detection speed and process restart latency.

scenarios.title: Zombie Process Reaping & PID Table Saturation
scenarios.description: Subshell worker spawner executing short-lived tasks that exit immediately without waitpid(). Evaluates PID 1 init reaper performance and PID table saturation defenses.

scenarios.title: Slowloris Attack Slow-Header Connection Starvation
scenarios.description: Slowloris driver opening 1,500 connections dripping 1 header byte every 5 seconds, attempting to hold connection pools open while legitimate traffic measures p95 latency.

scenarios.title: TCP Zero-Window Client Flow-Control Freeze
scenarios.description: Streaming HTTP server sending 10 MB payloads. Malicious client reads 64 KB then advertises win 0, testing kernel SO_SNDBUF saturation, persist timers, and backpressure isolation.

scenarios.title: Packet Corruption & Bit-Flip Checksum Rejection
scenarios.description: HTTP protocol parser service subjected to stream fuzzer sending malformed chunk sizes, bit-flipped frames, and 1,000-deep JSON. Verifies clean HTTP 400 rejection and 0 segfaults.

scenarios.title: Unix Domain Socket File Descriptors Unlinking
scenarios.description: IPC server communicating over /tmp/matrix_ipc.sock at 5,000 msgs/sec subjected to sudden unlink('/tmp/matrix_ipc.sock') at t=265s. Measures automatic socket re-binding and connection recovery.

scenarios.title: Cascading Worker Thread Deadlock and Timeout
scenarios.description: Multithreaded service with interdependent locks (Account A <-> Account B) subjected to inverted transfer requests. Tests pthread_mutex_timedlock, deadlock timeout, and 504 gateway response.

scenarios.title: Cgroup OOM 4 GB Memory Ceiling Hard Enforcement
scenarios.description: Pushes container memory allocations towards the strict 4,096 MB (4,294,967,296 bytes) cgroup v2 memory.max ceiling. Verifies container OOM killer triggers termination (exit code 137) while preserving host macOS headroom.

scenarios.title: 10,000 Concurrent Open Network Sockets
scenarios.description: High-capacity epoll server with nofile=65536. Slot C establishes and holds 10,000 live TCP connections, pulsing ping packets across sampled sockets to evaluate memory overhead and latency.

scenarios.title: Hackbench Context-Switch Scheduler Storm
scenarios.description: Native compiled hackbench running 50 groups of 20 thread pairs (1,000 threads) exchanging data over POSIX pipes, driving context switches beyond 500,000/sec to stress OS kernel schedulers.

scenarios.title: Epoll Event Queue Saturation (100k events)
scenarios.description: Epoll server configured with maxevents=100000 flooded with 1-byte ready signals across 5,000 sockets simultaneously, pushing 100,000 ready events/sec into the kernel epoll readiness list.

scenarios.title: cgroup io.max Block I/O Severe Throttling
scenarios.description: FIO block write harness writing 200 MB/s of 64 KB blocks to scratch NVMe under cgroup v2 io.max throttle (wbps=52428800 = 50 MB/s limit), evaluating PSI stall spikes.

scenarios.title: Fork Bomb Mitigation (pids.max boundary)
scenarios.description: Bounded recursive process forker pushing against container cgroup pids.max=2048 limit. When limit is reached, fork() returns EAGAIN while init process and container remain stable.

scenarios.title: Extreme Inode Depletion on Scratch Storage
scenarios.description: Creates 500,000 small files in hashed directories on /scratch to deplete filesystem inodes and stress kernel VFS dentry slab allocation and dcache eviction algorithms.

scenarios.title: Raw Socket SYN Flood Defense (SYN Cookies)
scenarios.description: Raw socket blaster streaming 100,000 SYNs/sec to target port with backlog=128. Kernel overflows listen queue and activates tcp_syncookies; verifies legitimate client connections succeed.
